questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
(saved with the handle) Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or LinkedIn
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word, the active element and the glow)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
(found on their computer) the caption font; left unset, the main bold is reused
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
If you ask for music: should I always check which track with you, or pick one of your favourites and tell you?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, reviews, screenshots, your own reel covers?
Besides your proof folder, are there other folders I should search for real things to show: screenshots, posts, documents, B-roll?
Do you want your handle drawn as a small watermark beside the graphics? (yes or no)
Emphasis words in a serif or italic look smaller than a bold sans at the same size. How much larger should they be set? 1.12 suits a serif italic; use 1.0 when the emphasis font is the main font.
Second line of each heading: on a solid block of your accent colour (block), or plain with a thin accent underline (underline)?
Should the head and raised hands rise above the top edge of the panel (on, needs a clean cut-out of the person), or stay inside the panel (off)?
Add a slow, eased zoom-out on every full-frame close-up? (on or off)
Should I show you the plan before building and the draft before the final render, or run to the end and report afterwards?
questions.default: show the plan before building and the draft before the final render
